title: A great way to learn about Spanish traditions while enjoying authentic flavors.
text: A fantastic experience combining food, culture, and stunning views of Seville! The rooftop setting was beautiful, the local wines and appetizers were delicious, and watching the paella and sangria preparation was a highlight.
author: paucxmbil

title: We did the Sangria...
text:
We did the Sangria tasting and followed withe paella demo.  The experience was a lot of fun.  They did not skimp on rations.  They gave plenty of sangria and paella.  
Maria, our host was knowledgeable and lots of fun!!!!!
author: IRENE_T

title: Such a lovely experience....
text: Such a lovely experience. Extremely accommodating to all my dietary requirements. Note that you don’t actually cook yourself but nevertheless was very involved. Views were incredible of the city but the building was a bit difficult to locate. Surprise dessert was delicious!! Definitely recommend
author: Hannah_P

title: We learned how easy...
text: We learned how easy paella is to make at home with simple and clear instructions with our chef, Fabio.  It was a relaxed, casual evening and we enjoyed having our paella with sangria in the patio afterwards.
author: Dorothy_M

title: Beautiful rooftop views
text: What an amazing experience! We got to experience how paella is made here in Spain and try local wines and cheeses. We also got to taste sangria while eating paella out on the beautiful rooftop of La Terraza del Cristina. Highly recommend this experience!
author: sarahfF7431ZF

title: Authentic Spanish Culinary Experience with Stunning Seville Views
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an unforgettable experience at La Terraza del Cristina! The panoramic views of Seville from the rooftop were absolutely breathtaking, especially seeing landmarks like the Triana Bridge and Torre del Oro while sipping local wine. The cooking demonstration was both fun and informative. Watching the chefs expertly prepare traditional Spanish dishes like paella and sangría made the experience even more immersive. The food was delicious, with fresh seafood paella and sangría that was perfectly balanced. The hosts were incredibly welcoming and knowledgeable, sharing great insights into
author: kensingtons2020

title: Great time
text: It was a pleasure learning about our favorite meal. The atmosphere was so amazing. Enjoy the experience
author: Eric_R

title: Super fun experience!
text: So much fun! Antonio was hilarious and gave us so many tips for cooking a paella! You get to enjoy the paella on a rooftop with stunning views. Definitely reccomend
author: Sophie_C

title: Great experience!!!!
text: This was a great evening.  Was very interactive and fun and learned a lot about how to make a “proper” paella.  Drinks and food were wonderful.  Highly recommend this!
author: Alison_T

title: This was really a...
text: This was really a fabulous experience in Seville.  Antonio was a perfect host/chef/guide.  The information that he provided while preparing the paella was excellent.  The food, drink and ambience was truly memorable.  The prep area for the demonstration was well organized - everyone had a great view of what he was doing at all times.  Eating out on the terrace was fantastic- great views and paella was excellent.  Highly recommend this tour
author: Cho_B
